title: Service plumbing
what: The service start and its commands, its settings, the routes behind the token, the SQLite store and its migrations, health, the event stream kept in the store, and the deployment unit and testbed declaration.

title: Personal-data check
what: The repository-wide check over every tracked file: no mail address outside the reserved example domains and the two values the repository allows, no home path of a person, no telephone number, token or private network address, as PERSONAL-DATA.md states it.
